response.original_title: AEW Dynamite : A Tribute to "The Bastard" Pac
response.overview: All Elite Wrestling is saddened to announce the passing of Benjamin Satterley, aka Pac. A native of Newcastle upon Tyne, England, Satterley began his wrestling career in 2004 and went on to perform for wrestling organizations all over the world, captivating fans with innovative high-flying moves and incredible in-ring ability.  Pac signed with All Elite Wrestling in 2019 and held multiple AEW Championships and competed in some of the most memorable matches in AEW history.  Our condolences go out to Satterley’s family, friends and fans.
response.title: AEW Dynamite : A Tribute to "The Bastard" Pac
